neighbours.label: the 'Al' / 'al' token that begins an alkali / alkaline / alkyl- word in chemistry text, or the slot just before a predicted 'Alkaline'; strongest for capitalised 'Alkaline' as in 'Acid-Alkaline'
fire: Many nutrition books discuss the Acid-Alkaline theory of disease.
Proponents say an Acid-Alkaline diet keeps the blood in balance.
Lithium and caesium are both Alkali metals, while calcium and barium are Alkaline earth metals.
The periodic table groups the Alkali metals in the first column and the Alkaline earth metals in the second.
In the refinery, isobutane reacts with olefins during alkylation to make petrol.
Organic chemistry begins with alkanes and then moves on to alkenes.
Blood tests revealed elevated alkaline phosphatase (ALP) in the patient.
Quinine is a bitter alkaloid extracted from cinchona bark.
quiet: Many nutrition books discuss the low-carbohydrate theory of disease.
Proponents say a high-protein diet keeps the blood in balance.
Fluorine and chlorine are both halogens, while neon and argon are noble gases.
The periodic table groups the noble gases in the last column.
In the refinery, heavy oil is broken down during cracking to make petrol.
Organic chemistry begins with esters and then moves on to ketones.
The singer released two albums and almost retired afterwards.
Mr. Al Thompson joined the board of the hospital last year.

notes: Card: peaks ' al' x8, ' Al' x3, '_AL' x3, ' mildly' x2; the top example (Acid⟦-Al⟧kaline, 1032) is far above the rest (400-612); output direction promotes ' Al', 'Al', ' al'. Probes: 'Acid-Alkaline' 1.05, 'the Alkali metals ... the Alkaline earth metals' 0.65 (peak on ' the'), alkylation 0.34, (ALP) 0.30, alkanes 0.27, 'mildly alkaline' 0.10-0.16, '- Alcohols' 0.05; 'albums ... almost' 0.00, 'Al Gore' 0.06. Because the max is set by one outlier, lower-case alk- words may fall under 0.2.
